name: Jackson · Tetons & Yellowstone
tagline: Mountain mornings and a two-park journey
summary: Base near Jackson for Grand Teton, then move closer to or inside Yellowstone for that park. Yellowstone is too large to experience well as repeated rushed drives from town.
seasonNote: Many park roads close for winter; November–spring access differs sharply from summer. Wildlife, snow and construction can delay drives.
arrival: Fly into JAC or arrive by road; reserve summer cars and accommodation early.
gettingAround: A car or organized tour is needed for most park exploration; observe wildlife from safe distances.
cashTip: Cards are common but signal is patchy; carry backup supplies. Budget excludes car/fuel and park passes. 2026 park rule: eligible non-US visitors aged 16+ pay an additional USD 100 at designated parks unless covered by a valid qualifying pass. The nonresident annual pass is USD 250. Verify party coverage; never assume USD 35 covers all visitors.
foodTip: Carry a picnic for park days and reserve town dinners during peak season.
buyTip: Buy locally made western craft or nature art; avoid animal products without clear legal provenance.
baseArea: Jackson for Grand Teton; move to Yellowstone lodging or another gateway for Yellowstone.

connections.note: A long road transfer, best broken with an overnight.
Approximate direct air time if available; road travel takes substantially longer and should be split.

reviewSummary: The researched listings highlight Jenny Lake and the Jackson Hole Aerial Tram. Wildlife tours have their own ratings, which should not be confused with park or animal-sighting guarantees.

items.name: Jenny Lake & Grand Teton
items.summary: Lake walks and mountain views are a strong first Teton day.
items.expect: Busy summer parking and optional boat services with separate charges.
items.tip: Arrive early; select a walk suited to conditions and keep wildlife distance.
items.priceNote: Base private-vehicle park admission up to USD 35, plus applicable nonresident charges; valid passes may cover fees. Boat tickets extra.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: The lake sits directly below the Teton Range, making the mountain scale easy to grasp.
Shore walks and optional boats provide different ways to spend the day.
visitFlow: Arrive early and choose a realistic shore or trail route.
Add a boat only if the current schedule and separate cost fit your plan.
items.tradeoffs: Busy summer parking and optional boat services with separate charges.

items.name: Mormon Row & Antelope Flats
items.summary: Historic barns sit beneath the Teton backdrop.
items.expect: Unpaved access and changing wildlife activity.
items.tip: Stay out of closed areas and never approach bison for a photograph.
items.priceNote: No additional charge beyond any applicable park admission.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: Historic barns provide a human-scale foreground to the mountains.
The open flats can add wildlife observation while keeping a respectful distance.
visitFlow: Check access roads and designated parking.
View the buildings from permitted paths and give wildlife ample room.
items.tradeoffs: Unpaved access and changing wildlife activity.

items.name: Old Faithful & Upper Geyser Basin
items.expect: A long drive from Jackson; plan a Yellowstone overnight and use official eruption predictions.
items.tip: Stay on boardwalks; the ground and water can be dangerously hot.
items.priceNote: Separate Yellowstone admission up to USD 35 per private vehicle plus applicable nonresident fees; qualifying pass may cover it.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: Geysers and boardwalks reveal an active geothermal landscape.
The surrounding Upper Geyser Basin adds much more to the visit than one eruption.
visitFlow: Plan a Yellowstone overnight and check current eruption predictions.
Watch from authorised areas and then walk a permitted basin loop.
items.tradeoffs: A long drive from Jackson; plan a Yellowstone overnight and use official eruption predictions.

items.name: Grand Prismatic Spring
items.summary: A colourful thermal spring is best paired with a Yellowstone basin day.
items.expect: Crowded parking, steam and seasonal trail access.
items.tip: Use only open signed routes; do not assume the overlook is open in every season.
items.priceNote: Included after Yellowstone admission or a valid qualifying pass.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: The spring’s colours and scale make a distinctive geothermal scene.
Boardwalk and seasonal overlook routes give different perspectives when open.
visitFlow: Check road and trail access before leaving your base.
Use only signed boardwalks or the open overlook trail.
items.tradeoffs: Crowded parking, steam and seasonal trail access.

items.name: Jackson Hole Aerial Tram
items.summary: A resort tram reaches high mountain views in the operating season.
items.expect: Wind, weather and seasonal schedules matter; summit temperatures differ from town.
items.tip: Check operating days and visibility before buying.
items.priceNote: Planning estimate for a sightseeing return ticket; ski products differ.

review.note: Exact attraction listing snapshot; review volume is not visitor count.

whyVisit: The tram gains substantial elevation without a long summit hike.
High mountain views show the valley and ranges from a different perspective than lakeside stops.
visitFlow: Check operating season, wind and visibility.
Ride with warm layers and use only open summit paths.
items.bestFor: A mountain panorama with a mechanical ascent
items.tradeoffs: Wind, weather and seasonal schedules matter; summit temperatures differ from town.

dayClusters.label: Jackson and Teton Village arrival day
dayClusters.note: Use Jackson for supplies and a relaxed town visit, then the tram only if weather and operating hours fit. Travel to Teton Village by road; this is not a continuous walking route.

dayClusters.label: Grand Teton historic viewpoints
dayClusters.note: Stay near Jackson/Grand Teton for this section. Use a relaxed early wildlife/viewpoint day, obey animal-distance rules and leave space for weather rather than inventing more stops.

dayClusters.label: A Jenny Lake park day
dayClusters.note: Keep the lake walks and any boat/shuttle arrangements on their own Grand Teton day. Confirm the route difficulty and allow for busy parking.

dayClusters.label: Move to Yellowstone for two basin days
dayClusters.note: Relocate to suitable Yellowstone or nearby lodging before these visits; do not commute from Jackson daily. Use one day for Old Faithful/Upper Geyser Basin and the other for Midway/Grand Prismatic. The second day continues the Yellowstone stay. Add a separate relocation buffer if seasonal roads or the chosen lodging require it.
